original.title: Experiential Learning : Experience as the Source of Learning and Development
original.note: OpenAlex record dated 1983 for the 1984 book.

core_idea: Learning is the process of creating knowledge through the transformation of experience. Kolb describes a cycle: concrete experience, reflective observation, abstract conceptualization and active experimentation. Learners differ in which parts of the cycle they prefer.
key_concepts_note: Use the concepts already stored for this theory in the library (theories.concepts).
when_to_use: How do students learn through internships, projects, simulations or fieldwork?
What role does reflection play in turning experience into learning?
Typical data: reflective journals, interviews, observation, pre/post assessment.
common_mistakes: Treating the cycle as fixed steps that happen in order.
Building a study on 'learning styles' matching, which has weak evidence.
Ignoring the social and emotional sides of learning from experience.

development.adds: Reflection-in-action and reflection-on-action in professional practice.
